'''Vermon Skeetz''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Apologize? APOLOGIZE! Aiieeeeee! That's not good enough, he must DIE!|Vermon Skeetz, about [[Akers Radch]]|<ref name="SWG:PR" />}}
Vermon Skeetz was mentally ill but managed to be fine as long as he took his medication. By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Vermon was captured by the [[Corellian slavers]] and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] in the [[Corellian Slaver Bunker]] near [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]]. During his captivity, he befriended with a man named [[Akers Radch]].<ref name="SWG:PR" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Vermon Skeetz finally managed to escape the bunker with a group of slaves led by [[Kyran Silene]]. The escaped slaves did not reach Tyrena and established a camp in the wilderness. However, Vermon lost his medicine during his escape and therefore experienced a psychotic episode.<ref name="SWG:PR" /> A spacer recruited by Kyran Silene's [[Madison Silene|wife]] later arrived at the camp.<ref name="SWG:TtB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Talk to Bandor|Corellia}}</ref> The spacer planed to infiltrate the bunker to find evidence of the slaver operations for the [[Corellian Security Force]].<ref name="SWG:IE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Incriminating Evidence" on Corellia</ref> The spacer also met in the camp a crazy Vermon Skeetz who was ordering to assassinate Akers Radch. Once in the bunker, the spacer met Akers and the man helped to retrieve Vermon's medicine.<ref name="SWG:PR" /> The spacer finally broadcasted the slavers' records on the CorSec emergency request channels,<ref name="SWG:IE" /> leading dozens of CorSec agents to quickly move to the slaver bunker and free all the slaves.<ref name="SWG:HbtKS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Head back to Kyran Silene|Corellia}}</ref> After he escapaded the bunker, Akers brought the medicine to Vermon who quickly recovered from his crisis and apologized for his aggressive behavior.<ref name="SWG:PR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vermon Skeetz was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:PR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Vermon Skeetz was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
